stops.name: Bernina
stops.detail: During the Bernina Standard Helicopter Round Flight, you'll discover the glacier world of the Bernina Massif. You'll fly close to Piz Bernina, the Biancograt, and past glaciers. The return flight over the lake landscape of the Upper Engadine completes your flying experience.
